|lore=Until being reunited with Yoda, Luke suspected that he had completed his training. Has a strong influence on the weak minded.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent’s alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke on owner’s Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).
|printings={{Card versions/Master Luke}}
|notes=Both versions allow one qualifying alien placement per battle. The period ownership rule makes the opponent the owner of the target, including ordinary ownership changes.
